theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_eval_comp_starProjection_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ w ∈ Vᗮ, ∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ γ = 0) → ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ β = ζ (β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
